newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - Global Broadcasting Systems Inc.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - Global Broadcasting Systems Inc.

text.p: Company Name Global Broadcasting Systems Inc
Total Class A shares to be offered 12.5 million
Class A shrs offered by company 12.5 million
Class A Shrs outstanding after ipo 13,106,575
Lead Underwriter Friedman Billings Ramsey & Co Inc

Business: New York company is a national televised home shopping retailer offering high quality merchandise at manufactures' direct prices that are up to 30 percent to 50 percent below those of its principal competitors.
Use of Proceeds: to finance pending acquisitions, purchase pledged securities, to pay fees and expenses in connection with offering and general corporate purposes.
Concurrently with the IPO, Global is offering up to $270 million in senior subordinated notes due 2007.
